c1-energetika-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Paks in Hungarian Electricity
c1-energetika-01.scenario: In a seminar on Hungarian energy you are asked about the Paks Nuclear Power Plant.
c1-energetika-01.prompt: Say when the first unit was connected to the grid and what share of electricity Paks gives.
cues: Give the month and year of the first unit
c1-energetika-01.target: 1982 decemberében az 1-es blokk rákapcsolódott az országos villamosenergia-hálózatra. Az erőmű ma a hazai áramtermelés mintegy felét adja.
c1-energetika-01.english: In December 1982 unit 1 was connected to the national grid. Today the plant provides about half of domestic electricity generation.
c1-energetika-01.canDo: I can describe the history of the Paks Nuclear Power Plant and its place in Hungarian electricity (*Paksi Atomerőmű, blokk, üzemidő-hosszabbítás*).

c1-energetika-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Paks II Agreement
c1-energetika-02.scenario: In a seminar you are asked about the Paks II agreement of 2014.
c1-energetika-02.prompt: Say what the agreement provided and what the critics say.
c1-energetika-02.target: 2014 januárjában a magyar és az orosz kormány két új blokk építéséről állapodott meg. A bírálók szerint a projekt az orosz technológiától való függőséget növeli.
c1-energetika-02.english: In January 2014 the Hungarian and Russian governments agreed on building two new units. According to the critics the project increases dependence on Russian technology.
c1-energetika-02.canDo: I can describe the Paks II agreement and the debate about it (*államközi szerződés, fővállalkozói szerződés*).

c1-energetika-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Danube Dispute
c1-energetika-03.scenario: In a seminar on the environment you are asked about the Bős–Nagymaros dispute.
c1-energetika-03.prompt: Say what the Danube Circle protested against and what the court decided in 1997.
c1-energetika-03.target: A Duna Kör a Bős–Nagymaros vízlépcső ellen tiltakozott. A hágai bíróság 1997-ben megállapította, hogy mindkét fél megszegett kötelezettségeket.
c1-energetika-03.english: The Danube Circle protested against the Bős–Nagymaros barrage. In 1997 the court in The Hague found that both sides had breached obligations.
c1-energetika-03.canDo: I can describe the Bős–Nagymaros dispute and the ruling of 1997 (*vízlépcső, Duna Kör, C-variáns*).

c1-energetika-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Geothermal Heating
c1-energetika-04.scenario: In a seminar on energy you are asked about geothermal heat in Hungary.
c1-energetika-04.prompt: Say why the Pannonian Basin is favourable and what Szeged does with thermal water.
cues: Say what is special about the basin
c1-energetika-04.target: A Pannon-medencében a hőmérséklet gyorsabban emelkedik a mélységgel, mint a világátlag. Szegeden a hévíz a távfűtés egy részét fedezi.
c1-energetika-04.english: In the Pannonian Basin the temperature rises faster with depth than the world average. In Szeged thermal water covers part of the district heating.
c1-energetika-04.canDo: I can describe geothermal energy in the Pannonian Basin and district heating in Szeged (*hévíz, távfűtés, visszasajtolás*).

c1-energetika-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Solar Boom
c1-energetika-05.scenario: In a seminar on energy you are asked about solar power in Hungary.
c1-energetika-05.prompt: Say how large solar capacity was by 2024 and what problem arises at midday.
cues: Give the capacity and the year
c1-energetika-05.target: 2024-re a napelemes kapacitás átlépte a hatezer megawattot. Délben a túltermelés miatt az áramár negatív lehet.
c1-energetika-05.english: By 2024 solar capacity had exceeded six thousand megawatts. At midday the overproduction can make the electricity price negative.
c1-energetika-05.canDo: I can describe the growth of solar power in Hungary and the problems it brings (*naperőmű, negatív áramár, tárolás*).

c1-energetika-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarian Energy in Summary
c1-energetika-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up Hungarian energy supply.
c1-energetika-consolidation.prompt: Sum it up in two sentences, using one fact from the nuclear part and one from the renewable part.
c1-energetika-consolidation.target: Paks a hazai áramtermelés mintegy felét adja. Szegeden a hévíz a távfűtés egy részét fedezi, a napenergia pedig 2024-re átlépte a hatezer megawattot.
c1-energetika-consolidation.english: Paks provides about half of domestic electricity generation. In Szeged thermal water covers part of the district heating, and solar power exceeded six thousand megawatts by 2024.
c1-energetika-consolidation.canDo: I can recount the history of Paks I and the debate about extending its lifetime.
